goals: Build an AI-free music and emotional wellbeing PWA for an adult patient pilot
Provide immediate guest listening with human-curated instrumentals and recorded nature
Maintain private accounts, playlists, optional paired mood check-ins, and 90-day deletion
Use Supabase private Storage grants, owner RLS, and private Realtime Broadcast channels
Support explicitly downloaded licensed recordings and public offline shell without caching private data
Maintain Vietnamese-default and English WCAG 2.2 AA interface with static calm mode
Validate accessible playback, offline recovery, security isolation, production builds, and 25 listeners
Document managed Vercel/Supabase operations, monitoring, rollback, and tested recovery
profile.projectType: AI-free Next.js App Router music and wellbeing PWA for adult cancer patients
constraints: Node.js 22, supported patched Next.js 16, React 19, strict TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS 4, npm lockfile
Read installed Next.js documentation before framework changes
No AI generation, models, chatbots, AI APIs, speech transcription, or AI content
Use human-created recordings with provenance, rights evidence, attribution, and audio review
Recreation and emotional support only; avoid diagnostic or treatment claims
Require separate consent for mood history; owner access only; delete after 90 days
Content administrators manage recordings and curated collections without access to patient mood histories
Private Storage, short-lived grants for published hosted recordings, validated server mutations, owner RLS
Authorized private Broadcast channels; refetch on reconnect; reject stale playlist revisions
Do not cache private pages, API responses, or signed URLs; store only eligible explicit downloads in IndexedDB
Vietnamese default and English parity; WCAG 2.2 AA; controls at least 44 CSS pixels; no automatic audio playback
Visible user-initiated YouTube embeds and ordinary Spotify links; no external-source downloads
Vercel Pro, Supabase Pro near Vietnam, transactional SMTP, target monthly operations US$50-100
No em dash; plain dashes only; no agent commit co-authors
Never manually edit CHANGELOG.md or generated files
One complete sentence per physical line in long Markdown
Prioritize quality, simplicity, robustness, scalability, and maintainability over development cost
Reproduce bugs through the closest practical end-user E2E journey before fixes
Fix observed UI defects, lint failures, test failures, and flakiness
Report actual device, screen-reader, cloud, backup restoration, and load checks honestly
